_meta.applyShapeNote: 2026-08-25: applyShape/applyOffsetK added as a tuning-selectable shape, defaulting to the shipped behaviour (sigmoid at offset 0) so nothing moves. A sigmoid is 0.5 at delta=0 for EVERY scale and steepness, so an unequipped attacker landed every status on a coin flip and a cc at parity was a permanent lock (measured, tools/CombatSim). Raising applyOffsetK moves the neutral point while keeping the status soft-counterable; applyShape=linearFromZero matches the evasion chain's rate contests instead and makes it hard-counterable. Both reachable, neither imposed.
